ref: #2 §5 Date: DateTrans takes java.text.SimpleDateFormat patterns [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bfbd16f66d33de4e10000000a42189e.html]; ADR-0003: each pattern is translated to an XPath picture and the date is parsed strictly; assumed reading: the date read in sourceFormat is written in targetFormat (obs-date dateTrans-001)
note: sourceFormat yyyyMMdd, targetFormat dd.MM.yyyy: Sku in context Orders is 20261104, 20240229, 19991231, 00010101. Each date is written as day, month and year with dots, so All is 04.11.2026, 29.02.2024, 31.12.1999, 01.01.0001: the leap day stays, and the year keeps its four places.
